parole.testo: From Ottoman Turkish پاسقالیه (paskalya), borrowed from Greek Πασχαλιά (Paschaliá, “Eastertide”), from Byzantine Greek Πασχαλία (Paskhalía), from Koine Greek πασχάλιος (paskhálios, adjective) in the phrase πασχαλία γιορτή (paskhalía giortḗ, “Easter feast”), from Koine Greek πάσχα (páskha, “Passover”
